tables.name: schema_migrations
tables.purpose: Immutable migration version, checksum, and application-time ledger.

tables.name: organizations
tables.purpose: Screening program or organization identity and status.

tables.name: locations
tables.purpose: Canonical physical or operational screening location.

tables.name: desktop_installations
tables.purpose: Registered desktop deployment, organization, location, timezone, and lifecycle.

tables.name: desktop_installation_credentials
tables.purpose: Hashed installation credential lifecycle and rotation metadata; never stores plaintext tokens.

tables.name: location_source_links
tables.purpose: Stable mapping from installation-local locations to canonical locations.

tables.name: practitioners
tables.purpose: Canonical practitioner attribution used by accepted screenings.

tables.name: practitioner_source_links
tables.purpose: Installation-local practitioner to canonical practitioner mapping.

tables.name: practitioner_roles
tables.purpose: Practitioner role within an organization and location context.

tables.name: screening_protocols
tables.purpose: Versioned central screening protocol definition and lifecycle.

tables.name: protocol_source_links
tables.purpose: Installation-local protocol version to canonical protocol mapping.

tables.name: operations_users
tables.purpose: Enrolled OIDC operations principal and account status.

tables.name: operations_access_grants
tables.purpose: Time-bounded permission and organization-scope grants for operations users.

tables.name: persons
tables.purpose: Canonical patient demographics, acknowledgment state, and lifecycle.

tables.name: person_identifiers
tables.purpose: Typed canonical identifiers, including the active CHS medical ID.

tables.name: patient_source_links
tables.purpose: Stable installation-local patient to canonical person mapping and source revision.

tables.name: identity_review_cases
tables.purpose: Possible-duplicate review lifecycle without automatic patient merging.

tables.name: identity_review_candidates
tables.purpose: Bounded candidate references and matching evidence categories for a review case.

tables.name: identity_review_evidence_snapshots
tables.purpose: Minimum-necessary immutable review evidence by source revision.

tables.name: identity_review_resolutions
tables.purpose: Immutable reviewed decision, operator, target person, and resolved medical ID.

tables.name: identity_resolution_deliveries
tables.purpose: Replay-safe delivery and acknowledgment of central identity decisions to desktops.

tables.name: medical_id_recovery_cases
tables.purpose: Expiring audited verification state for revealing an existing CHS medical ID.

tables.name: medical_id_recovery_candidates
tables.purpose: Opaque candidate references retained only for an active recovery case.

tables.name: screening_sessions
tables.purpose: Canonical location/day screening session with protocol and practitioner provenance.

tables.name: screening_encounters
tables.purpose: Canonical patient screening encounter, lifecycle, attribution, and amendment links.

tables.name: screening_vital_sets
tables.purpose: One canonical vitals aggregate per encounter with optional anthropometrics.

tables.name: vital_readings
tables.purpose: Individual ordered blood-pressure and pulse measurements with source time.

tables.name: lifestyle_assessments
tables.purpose: Finalized seven-day Lifestyle assessment and exact baseline references.

tables.name: lifestyle_alcohol_baselines
tables.purpose: Immutable versioned alcohol-use baseline referenced by assessments.

tables.name: lifestyle_alcohol_baseline_beverages
tables.purpose: Normalized beverage details belonging to an alcohol baseline version.

tables.name: lifestyle_alcohol_weekly
tables.purpose: Finalized weekly alcohol-use response for one assessment.

tables.name: lifestyle_alcohol_weekly_beverages
tables.purpose: Normalized beverage details belonging to a weekly alcohol response.

tables.name: lifestyle_tobacco_baselines
tables.purpose: Immutable versioned tobacco-use baseline referenced by assessments.

tables.name: lifestyle_tobacco_products
tables.purpose: Approved normalized tobacco product vocabulary.

tables.name: lifestyle_tobacco_baseline_products
tables.purpose: Product-specific quantities belonging to a tobacco baseline version.

tables.name: lifestyle_tobacco_weekly
tables.purpose: Finalized weekly tobacco-use response and normalized products.

tables.name: lifestyle_work_baselines
tables.purpose: Immutable versioned work and job-activity baseline.

tables.name: lifestyle_work_weekly
tables.purpose: Finalized weekly work-activity response.

tables.name: lifestyle_physical_activities
tables.purpose: Approved normalized physical-activity vocabulary.

tables.name: lifestyle_physical_activity_weekly
tables.purpose: Ordered weekly physical-activity entries for an assessment.

tables.name: lifestyle_other_activities
tables.purpose: Approved normalized other-activity vocabulary.

tables.name: lifestyle_other_activity_weekly
tables.purpose: Ordered weekly other-activity entries for an assessment.

tables.name: sync_batches
tables.purpose: Authenticated batch envelope, payload hash, completion state, counts, and stored response.

tables.name: sync_batch_actors
tables.purpose: Batch-local actor references resolved to canonical practitioners.

tables.name: sync_records
tables.purpose: Per-record idempotency ledger, safe outcomes, stable error codes, and canonical links; no raw payload.

tables.name: audit_events
tables.purpose: Append-only operational and access audit events with minimum-necessary metadata.
